task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 — Fix design artefact for GH-821 / ISS-0718.

Diagnosis (Step 1) confirms the fix is already applied: commit bc9af23f changed the hardcoded UUID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ff' to the all-zeros sentinel '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' in par02_partition_catalog_test.zig:177. The lint_test_isolation.py linter exempts all-zeros UUIDs and reports no violations.

Produce a design artefact at src/design/WF03-GH821-fix-design.md that:
1. Describes the root cause (T010 violation: non-zero sentinel UUID used as tenant context in test fixture)
2. Confirms the fix already applied at bc9af23f: UUID changed to 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (all-zeros sentinel, correct for platform-level operations, explicitly exempted by lint)
3. States: 'No new code changes are required. BACKEND-DEV Step 3 is a verification step only — run python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration and confirm exit 0.'
4. Acceptance criteria for BACKEND-DEV: lint exits 0, zig build test-env-verify C5 gate passes
acceptance_criteria: Design explains the root cause and the already-applied fix
Design explicitly states no new code changes are needed
Design specifies the verification commands BACKEND-DEV must run

result.summary: Fix design for GH-821/ISS-0718 (T010 hardcoded UUID): root cause documented, applied fix at bc9af23f confirmed correct (all-zeros sentinel, linter-exempted), no new code required, BACKEND-DEV Step 3 is verification-only.
